|translation='''Title:''' Rug Hug.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. If Luke and Chewie are in a battle together, you may add two extra battle destiny. If you have a Rebel and an alien in a battle together, you may add 4 to power.

'''Lore:'''
Wookiees have rich emotions and are known for protecting family and friends. Chewbacca had come to treat Luke as a member of his own family.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 毛皮の抱擁.
